scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
If you have 1 ^0000cd{0}^000000 and a ^0000cd{1}^000000, I will grant you the power of the Goddess.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
如果您擁有1個^0000cd{0}^000000和1個^0000cd{1}^000000，我將賜予您女神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I'll do a good job. Leave it to me.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我會好好做的。請放心交給我。

scripts.text: What is a Goddess' power?
scripts.translation: 女神的力量是什麼？

scripts.text: Well then, please.
scripts.translation: 那就拜託了。

scripts.text: It's nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
What is the power of a Goddess? Did you just ask about the power of the Goddess?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
女神的力量是什麼？您剛才問的是女神的力量嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes. I asked.
scripts.translation: 是的。我問了。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I'd like to talk to you, please listen.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我想和您談談，請聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Power of the Goddess!!! I love the Goddess! Goddess, you're awesome!!!
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
女神的力量！！！我愛女神！女神，您太棒了！！！

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
There's a story that needs to be told first.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
首先，有一個故事需要講述。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I've always been a fan of the ^0000cdGoddess^000000. As I entered the temple and started my life as a devoted follower, my life began to blossom.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我一直都是^0000cd女神^000000的信徒。當我進入神殿，開始作為虔誠信徒的生活時，我的人生開始綻放。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
One day before I went to sleep, I had a ^0000cddream^000000 while I way praying to the Goddess.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
有一天，在我入睡之前，我在向女神祈禱時做了一個^0000cd夢^000000。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I heard the ^0000cdvoice^000000 of Goddess Freya in the full light.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
在明亮的光芒中，我聽到了女神芙蕾雅的^0000cd聲音^000000。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
But unfortunately, as soon as I woke up, I forgot all about my dream. That's how dreams are.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
但不幸的是，我一醒來就忘記了夢裡的所有事情。夢就是這樣的。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I cried endlessly because I felt sorry for that fact. But if the Goddess lets me hear her voice through a dream, wouldn't we too, be able to reach the Goddess through dreaming?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我為此感到難過，不停地哭泣。但如果女神能通過夢讓我聽到她的聲音，那我們是否也能通過夢與女神溝通呢？

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I started to study dreams with all my passion. I thought this was the will of the Goddess, who's trying to convey to me through them.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我開始滿懷熱情地研究夢。我認為這是女神的旨意，她正試圖通過夢向我傳達什麼。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
While I was working hard on my research, I made the ^0000cdPassage of Dreams^000000 at the request of our aunt, High Priestess Niren, who's right next to me. It's the result of what I dedicated my life to.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
在我努力研究的同時，應我們阿姨、大祭司尼倫的要求，我製作了^0000cd夢境通道^000000。她就在我的旁邊。這是我畢生心血的結晶。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I can't reach the Goddess yet... But there aren't many people who encounter the Goddess in their dreams... Like me...
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我還沒有能接觸到女神...但能在夢中遇到女神的人並不多...像我一樣...

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Anyway, when I first heard the request from our aunt, High Priestess Niren, I was surprised.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
總之，當我第一次聽到我們阿姨、大祭司尼倫的請求時，我很驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Would you dare to enter the Pope's dream...? The High Priestess Niren convinced me to enter her dream, but there was nothing that I could do to help her.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
您敢進入教皇的夢中嗎？大祭司尼倫說服我進入她的夢，但我能做的幫助卻很少。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
And the persuasion was surprisingly convincing.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
而且她的勸說出乎意料地有說服力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what's the Power of the Goddess?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，女神的力量究竟是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
When I first entered the Pope's dream, I was amazed.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
當我第一次進入教皇的夢境時，我驚呆了。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Of my ^0000cdgenius^000000.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
驚歎於我^0000cdgenius^000000的天賦。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Can anyone else in the world create a device that allows them to enter other people's dreams and experience them vividly? Kya- After all, Goddess' beloved lamb.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
這世上還有誰能製造出能進入他人夢境並身臨其境體驗的裝置呢？哎呀——畢竟，女神最鍾愛的羔羊。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
As I was walking through the Pope's dream, I accidentally found a ^0000cdPriest's Necklace^000000 from the priest and a special energetic ^0000cdFragment^000000 from the faceless shrine there.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
在教皇的夢境中漫步時，我偶然發現了一枚來自牧師的^0000cd牧師項鍊^000000，以及來自那裡無面神龕的一塊充滿能量的^0000cd碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
And I went around trying to find out as much as I could in my dreams, but when the Pope found me, she rejected me fiercely in fear.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我在夢境中四處探索，試圖瞭解儘可能多的資訊，但當教皇發現我時，她因恐懼而激烈地拒絕了我。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I'm not the Pope's closest confidant, so I must have been just a stranger to her.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我並非教皇最親密的知己，對她來說，我大概只是個陌生人吧。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
So I was thrown out of the Pope's dream.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
於是，我被趕出了教皇的夢境。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
By the way. When I woke up from my dream, I had the Priest's Necklace from the shrine and the strange fragment still in my hands. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
順便說一下。當我從夢中醒來時，手中還握著來自神龕的牧師項鍊和那塊奇怪的碎片。你覺得這說明了什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Amazing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太不可思議了。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Oh Goddess, please pity the blunt sensibility of an adventurer who can express these tremendous results in a word that is just amazing-
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
噢，女神啊，請憐憫這位冒險者遲鈍的感知力吧，竟然只用“不可思議”這一個詞來形容如此驚人的成果——

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I was able to bring out the things I got from other people's dreams. This is a big deal! Let's get down to business because you don't seem to empathize.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我竟然能把從他人夢境中獲取的東西帶出來！這可是大事！看來你並不太能共情，那我們還是言歸正傳吧。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I began to study the necklace and the strange fragment of the shrine. The strange fragment was named the ^0000cdDream Fragment^000000, meaning the fragment obtained in a dream. Kyah- Name Sense!
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我開始研究那枚項鍊和神龕的奇怪碎片。那塊奇怪的碎片被命名為^0000cd夢之碎片^000000，意為在夢中獲得的碎片。哎呀——這命名感真不錯！

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
They seemed normal when being separated, however I felt a subtle energy when I stacked them on top of each other.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
它們分開時看起來都很普通，但當我把它們疊放在一起時，我感到了一股微妙的能量。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
From then on, I entered the Pope's dream and began to study by collecting them one by one, without being noticed by the Pope.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
從那以後，我進入教皇的夢境，開始在不被教皇察覺的情況下，逐一收集它們進行研究。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I discovered that by collecting about ^0000cd100 Dream Fragments^000000, compressing them with force, and putting them into the ^0000cdPriest's Necklace^000000, I can grant it ^0000cdspecial powers^000000.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我發現，收集大約^0000cd100個夢之碎片^000000，用力壓縮它們，並放入^0000cd牧師項鍊^000000中，就能賦予它^0000cd特殊力量^000000。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
And by continuously researching and researching, I've succeeded in separating that power into three degrees.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
經過持續的研究，我成功地將那股力量分為了三個等級。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
This power can help the wearer's ^0000cdphysical^000000, ^0000cdmagical^000000, or ^0000cdranged^000000 attacks. Without any side effects!
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
這股力量可以增強佩戴者的^0000cd物理^000000、^0000cd魔法^000000或^0000cd遠端^000000攻擊。而且沒有任何副作用！

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
I gave these powers the names of ^0000cdGoddess of Justice, Goddess of Mercy, Goddess of Insight^000000, respectively. Isn't that plausible?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
我分別將這些力量命名為^0000cd正義女神、慈悲女神、洞察女神^000000。聽起來很合理吧？

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
But what's even more surprising is that if you put a larger amount of ^0000cdDream Fragments^000000, that's about ^0000cd1000pcs^000000 or so, you can enchant an even more ^0000cdpowerful power^000000.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
但更令人驚訝的是，如果你放入更多^0000cd夢之碎片^000000，大約^0000cd1000個^000000左右，就能賦予它更加^0000cd強大的力量^000000。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Any more than that, the Priest's Necklace couldn't hold up to, so all the items I've gathered were destroyed. I'm still working on it, so I'm sure I'll succeed someday.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
再多放一些的話，牧師項鍊就承受不住了，所以我收集的所有材料都毀了。不過我還在努力研究中，相信總有一天會成功的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, give me a three-line summary.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，請給我做一個三句話的總結。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Oh my, what should I do with this person? Still, I'm a kind Lamb of the Goddess, so I'll tell you briefly.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
哎呀，該怎麼跟這個人說呢？不過，我是女神溫柔的羔羊，就簡單告訴您吧。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
If you bring me ^0000cd1 Priest's Necklace and 100 Dream Fragments^000000 obtained in a dream, your ^0000cdPriest's Necklace will be enchanted with the Power of the Goddess^000000.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
如果您帶來^0000cd1個牧師項鍊和100個夢之碎片^000000（在夢中獲得），您的^0000cd牧師項鍊就會被賦予女神的力量^000000。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
And if you bring an enchanted ^0000ffPriest's Necklace with Goddess Power^000000 and ^0000ff1000 pieces of Dream Fragments^000000, you'll get even more power.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
如果您帶來已經附魔了^0000ff女神力量的牧師項鍊^000000和^0000ff1000個夢之碎片^000000，您將獲得更強大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
That's it!
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
就是這樣！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, thank you.

[Temple Item Manager]
Would you like to hear it one more time?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
您想再聽一遍嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no, that's enough. That's all right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用了，夠了。這樣就好。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Oh, that's a shame. I was going to go into more detail this time.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
哎呀，真遺憾。我本來還想這次講得更詳細一點的。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Great decision! Do you want it on your ^0000cdleft^000000? Or the ^0000cdright^000000 side? I'm confident either way!...
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
好決定！您想附魔在^0000cd左邊^000000還是^0000cd右邊^000000？無論哪邊我都很有信心！...

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左路

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右路

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Oh, why!!! I'm being nice to you!!!
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
哎呀，為什麼啊！！！我明明是在為您好！！！

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Uh, wait! That's not the ^0000cd{0}^000000, is it? Can you check it again?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
呃，等等！這不是^0000cd{0}^000000吧？您可以再檢查一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
What special abilities would you like to enchant your necklace with?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
您想為您的項鍊附魔哪種特殊能力？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: A Class
scripts.translation: A級

scripts.text: S Class
scripts.translation: S級

scripts.text: No, I need time to consider.
scripts.translation: 不，我需要時間考慮一下

scripts.text: Yes, please proceed.
scripts.translation: 是的，請繼續。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
You aren't wearing the {0}...!
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
您沒有佩戴{0}...

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Your {0} already has an enchant.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
您的{0}已經有附魔了。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
You didn't bring enough {0}!
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
您帶來的{0}不夠！

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
You need to have your necklace enchanted with {0} first.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
您需要先讓項鍊附魔{0}。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
The necklace has been enchanted according to your specifications.
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
項鍊已按照您的要求完成附魔。

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Nothing? Did you forget what to say?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
沒什麼事嗎？您是不是忘了要說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
If you're not busy right now, would you like to eat with me?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
如果您現在不忙的話，願意和我一起吃頓飯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Why don't you take the time with me to talk about dreams, science, and the goddess?
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
不如利用這段時間，和我聊聊夢想、科學以及女神吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I'm busy so...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我現在很忙，所以...

scripts.text:
[Temple Item Manager]
Even if you have nothing to say, just listen to me!!!
scripts.translation:
[神殿物品管理員]
就算您無話可說，也請聽我說！！！
